entry.title: New: dsh-cue-bank
entry.summary: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching). Exact install spec: github:itr-del/dsh-cue-bank. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
